description: BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments is an open data portal listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by BODIK (Open Data Catalogue Service of Japanese local governments). BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments. This harvest searched it with infrastructure and hazard phrases in English and Japanese and read 3,871 datasets; the ones whose titles name a transport, energy, water, digital or facility element or a hazard are catalogued as records of their own, and the rest (statistics, laws, contracts ... Coverage: Japan. 3,871 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 870 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
